description: Interleaved A/Bs of bench-rs on the Pixel 8 Pro (measure.py building blocks): policy_variants = main (727d266), bv (a viewport beyond, with D471, D472), b2 (two beyond, placed), b0 (none beyond, the shipped policy before its estimate rounding and trim slack changes); shipped = main against the committed code; grid = the grid screen fast flings of both apps before D474 (3 runs here; 3 more, not kept, composed in 11, 2 and 2 frames) and after it. See docs/15, The lazy list policy. after_review = main against the code after the review fixes (D475-D478), 8 runs. after_third_review = main against the code after D479-D485, 8 runs; grid_after_third_review = the grid fast flings then. after_fourth_review = main against the code after D486-D491, 8 runs (an empty feed trace of main left out); grid_after_fourth_review = the grid fast flings then.
